user.title: Guida TV
user.description: Add the Guida TV integration. It scrapes guidatv.org for the channel list (name + number) and the programme guide (yesterday to the day after tomorrow).

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Force an immediate update of channels and guide.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Return the filtered programme guide in a reusable format.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: One or more channel slugs (e.g. rai-1). Empty = all channels.

date.name: Date
date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or a keyword: ieri, oggi, domani, dopodomani.

get_channels.name: Get channels
get_channels.description: Return the full channel list (number, name, slug, logo, logo_local, category).
